name: Court
overview: Scripture, as illustrated in Exodus 18:21-26, emphasizes the importance of establishing godly leadership to administer justice within the community. Moses was advised to appoint able men who feared God and were men of truth to serve as rulers over various groups, judging the people at all times and reserving difficult cases for higher authority. This divinely ordained system ensured that justice was carried out faithfully and that the people could live in peace under righteous governance.
